summary: Data audit clean on all six channels (one YouTube view correction, not a bug). Fixed two small generator bugs, wrote 7 video verdicts and Paisa Panchayat's weekly review, handed 3 Disaster Desk notes on.
why: Facts dated by year only (119 of 994) were never checked for a newer release, and a Commons TIFF thumbnail was cached under the wrong extension; both fixed with tests that fail on the old code.

findings.title: Going Down: dashboard 434 views, YouTube 363 (v-20261121-54)
findings.detail: The live count only takes numbers YouTube returned, so YouTube removed about 71 views after counting them; the dashboard follows after two matching lower reads.

findings.title: Paisa Panchayat: 07:07 IST Shorts get the most views
findings.detail: Median 477 views at 48 hours (12 Shorts) against 133 at 19:07 (15), same stayed-to-watch rate.

findings.title: McDonald's worker vs CEO Short: 1,194 views, 48.4% stayed
findings.detail: Biggest fall, 18.5 points, at 5.3 s on the 'worker in Poland' twist.

changes.title: Old facts dated by year, month or quarter are now checked
changes.detail: generator/topics.py: stale_facts reads '2024', '2024-03', '2024-Q3' as the last day they cover (gen-008).

changes.title: A TIFF's PNG thumbnail is cached as .png
changes.detail: generator/media/library.py fetch names the file after what downloaded (gen-007).
